Title: We are retiring Azure Cognitive Services Text Analytics v2.x on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because Azure Cognitive Services Text Analytics v3 provides broader language coverage and expanded capabilities and flexibility on model version control, we are retiring v.2x of Text Analytics on 29 February 2024. We encourage you to make the switch early to gain the benefits of the new Text Analytics v3. 

Action required 

Follow the steps outlined in the migration document to update your workloads to Azure Text Analytics v3 before 29 February 2024. After 29 February 2024, the Text Analytics v2.x will no longer be supported. 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
